integrity: Finite enumerations corroborate a separate all-order algebraic proof. No formal, external-expert or historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats fair independent edges and parity only, not biased edge probabilities, exact integer-degree conditioning, or full critical-group structure. Historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: An exact degree-parity conditional law for odd spanning-tree counts in uniform random graphs
